grid.noLinesDescription: Füge eine Zeile hinzu, um ein Ausgabenlimit für eine Gruppe von Kategorien festzulegen.

behaviorDescription.budget_another: Budgets the amount fresh each period. Spending along the way is expected and never changes the ask.
behaviorDescription.refill_up_to: Refills the line to the target each period. Whatever is left over counts, so you assign only the gap.
behaviorDescription.reach_balance: Tracks the balance itself. Spending sets progress back and raises the ask right away.

goals.refillUpToHint: The balance to restore each period.
goals.totalToBudgetHint: Split across the periods until the date.
goals.openEndedHint: No deadline. Progress tracks the line balance.
goals.firstDueDateHint: Repeats yearly on this date. Funding is spread across the periods before it.
goals.repeatHint: Start a new cycle after the due period.
goals.stopAtBalanceHint: Stop asking once the saved balance (carryover plus assigned) reaches this cap.
